style_guardrails: Fully original designs only; do not imitate licensed media styles.
Clean 1-2px vector-friendly line art with flat-to-soft shading.
Reverent, uplifting, all-ages tone; expressive but not childish faces.
No text, logos, modern props, or photoreal rendering.

mentor_bases.david: 28-year-old shepherd, curly black hair, olive skin, sling, beige tunic with gold accents
mentor_bases.moses: Elderly white beard, weathered face, staff, red robe with bronze trim
mentor_bases.esther: Young queen, dark wavy hair, gold crown, purple gown with silver trim
mentor_bases.ruth: Gentle 25-year-old, warm brown eyes, wheat sheaf, tan robe with olive-green outline
mentor_bases.paul: Middle-aged, short dark hair, scarred hands, gray tunic, chains only when relevant
